critical_code_review_comments: CvProfessional.jsx line 74 renders payment method as `${account_number} a.n. ${m.account_name}` — matches admin form fields (account_name) so OK; document naming: backend accepts arbitrary keys via `payment_methods: list` (no schema), so any typo in future would silently pass. Consider tightening with Pydantic model per PaymentMethod.
Backend admin_cv_cancel does not require reason/notes; consider logging notes for audit clarity (currently write_cv_log passes empty notes).
expire_cv_subscriptions() runs on every /status call — fine for small volumes; if usage grows consider a background scheduler.

require_cv_premium redirect on frontend is client-side only (via useEffect); the server correctly enforces 403, but for UX any deep-link to `/builder/:id` from bookmark on expired user briefly shows spinner before redirect (acceptable).
cv-settings-form: payment_methods array has no server-side validation for required fields (empty name/account_number saved as-is); minor UX issue only.
